title: chart learn does not raise KeyError answer when the embed reply carries none
intention: chart learn over a berth that the embed host cannot answer ends in a loud, named refusal (Law 7), never a bare KeyError.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: chart learn raised KeyError: 'answer' on akiendell; deposit.py:50 and :60 index ['answer']['vector'] with no guard
traces_to: Law 7: errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces, and a bare KeyError names nothing. Law 3: the failing reply must be measured before the fix.
how: Capture the actual reply that lacks 'answer' on akiendell, then make deposit.embed and embed_metered name the refusal; the red-first proof feeds a reply without 'answer'.

clauses.claim: a resolve reply without 'answer' makes embed and embed_metered raise an error that names the reply's own error field, not KeyError
a reply carrying answer.vector still returns the vector unchanged

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: chart learn raised KeyError: 'answer' on akiendell; deposit.py:50 and :60 index ['answer']['vector'] with no guard
measured.how: orchestrator report plus git grep of ['answer'] over cairn/ (the failing reply is not captured: HYPOTHESIS that it is the embed host being unreachable)
